notes: A beam of light rises from the bomb in the color of the team carrying it (orange while it's loose), so even in a pile of players you can tell who has it. Thanks to play-tester Kirsten for the idea!
If your party's leader leaves while searching for a game, everyone else is told the search stopped, and who's leading now.
